title: Florida House, District 84
what_it_does: Represents District 84 (Part of St. Lucie) in the Florida House; votes on state laws and the state budget.
verified_ballot_note: Candidate list taken from the Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list on 2026-09-18 (https://dos.elections.myflorida.com/candidates/CanList.asp); statuses Qualified/Unopposed only. Counties from the Legislature's district listings. Positions have not been researched yet.

candidates.name: Dana Trabulsy
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.occupation: Director of public relations and special projects, The Children's Forum; former small business owner; state representative since 2020
candidates.background: Dana Trabulsy, 62, of Fort Pierce, has lived in St. Lucie County for more than 33 years and has represented District 84 in the Florida House since 2020. She worked in corporate jobs and owned a small business and digital media platform, and now works for The Children's Forum, an early-learning nonprofit. She is married with four children and seven grandchildren.

candidates.name: Jennifer Massey
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.occupation: Associate Director of Research & Education, Paralyzed Veterans of America
candidates.background: Jennifer Massey, 44, of Port St. Lucie, works as associate director of research and education for Paralyzed Veterans of America and says she has more than 20 years of leadership and management experience. She describes herself as a mother, advocate and community leader involved in youth, education and local safety initiatives.
